name: tablestudio
title: TableStudio
description: Search your TableStudio connections, tables and views and open them straight in the app, and start or stop your local database servers.
author: johntan

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Databases
commands.subtitle: TableStudio
commands.description: Find a connection, table or view and open it in TableStudio. Filter by kind in the search bar, or press ↵ on a connection to browse just its tables.

commands.name: localdatabases
commands.title: Manage Local Databases
commands.subtitle: TableStudio
commands.description: Start or stop the database servers TableStudio runs on this Mac.

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: Access Token
preferences.description: Usually filled in for you by the Connect Raycast button in TableStudio → Settings → Search & Launchers. Paste it here only if you'd rather set it manually.

preferences.name: port
preferences.title: Port
preferences.description: Only needed if you set the token manually and changed the port from 7432.

preferences.name: cacheResults
preferences.title: Offline Access
preferences.label: Keep a copy for when TableStudio isn't running
preferences.description: Stores the list inside Raycast so you can still search when the app is closed. Turn off to keep nothing at rest.
